basic_info.description: Built in 1989, this freshly painted move-in-ready home offers substantial square footage of updated living space. Featuring 4 beds,  2 baths, wide plank oak colored floors, and  a  modern wood-burning fireplace, it boasts a spacious entry hall with separate glass door and a peg coat rack. The bright living room with high ceilings and skylight offers northern views, including Sutro Tower. A formal dining area with Juliet balcony leads to an open kitchen with a large peninsula and stainless steel appliances. Upstairs,  two substantial bedrooms provide deck access,  while two downstairs bedrooms include ample storage. The spacious two-car side-by-side garage and driveway parking add convenience. Enjoy a huge low maintenance level backyard with a private fence and basketball hoop. Convenient location within walking distance to Balboa BART and minutes to Balboa Park, Mission Corridor businesses, City college, Ocean ave, H-Mart, and I-280 freeway entrance.
